_comment: Single source of truth for the canton-section Pages-shard mechanism (push-section-shard.sh, strip-section-subtree.sh, deploy.yml, post-deploy-validate-dist.yml). Each locale value is the URL slug ONLY (no locale prefix) — consumers derive the dist subtree path as: it -> "<slug>", en/de/fr -> "<loc>/<slug>". Values verified against data/canton-url-slugs.json + build-plugins/shared/cantonResolvers.mjs (resolveCantonSection). The Cloudflare Worker (infra/cloudflare-worker/locale-router.js) cannot import this file (must stay a single self-contained paste-able script per its own header comment) so it mirrors these same literal values inline in SECTION_ROUTES — keep both in sync if a slug ever changes.
